title: Simplified Process for Internal Market Movements (SPIMM): Category of goods guidance
text: With the publication of the Windsor Framework , goods moving from Great Britain (GB) to Northern Ireland (NI) are considered to be either Category 1, Category 2 or Standard goods. Category 1, Category 2 or standard goods. Category 1 and Category 2 goods are covered by the legislation detailed in Annex IX of Decision of the Withdrawal Agreement Joint Committee on laying down arrangements relating to the Windsor Framework. The types of goods and specific requirements are listed in this guidance.
changeNote: The guidance has been updated to include measures relating to sanctions and steel products and to provide clearer information on the application of exemptions and waivers.
